title: Resolve dynamic HDR encode preservation decisions
summary: Adds a pure Dynamic HDR encode-preservation decision resolver that folds existing evidence, policy, MKV-only output support, tool availability, and x265 capability into a side-effect-free decision object for future Do-Encode wiring.
reason: The eventual Dynamic HDR encode hook needs a small tested decision contract before it can safely skip GPU attempts, trigger extraction, prefer remux, or hold review under opt-in preserve policies.
behavior_before: Dynamic HDR had evidence, a preservation truth-table planner, x265 parameter slots, extraction planning, and extraction execution helpers, but no single encode-facing decision object describing the future Do-Encode actions.
behavior_after: Resolve-DynamicHdrEncodePreservationDecision returns a dynamic_hdr_encode_preservation_decision.v1 object with action, recommended route, extraction/CPU/GPU booleans, hold-review/remux flags, reason codes, target profile, artifacts, caveats, and the underlying preservation plan. It remains pure and is not consumed by Do-Encode yet.
tests_added: Extended ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-DynamicHdrToolingChecks.ps1 with encode preservation decision cases for missing evidence, no metadata, warn policy, satisfied CPU preservation, missing tool remux preference, unsupported profile review hold, and non-MKV container handling.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet plus Resolve-DynamicHdrEncodePreservationDecision, its unit cases, the Dynamic HDR docs/status updates, and generated summaries. Earlier extraction planner/executor and x265 parameter wiring commits remain separate.
notes:
Add pure Dynamic HDR encode-preservation decision resolver.
Cover encode preservation decision truth table for warn, preserve, remux, review, and container guards.
Reflect encode decision resolver progress while keeping Do-Encode wiring open.
Update active gap summary for Dynamic HDR decision resolver progress.
Record decision-gating resolver status and remaining runtime hook work.
Refresh summary after active-state documentation update.
Refresh Dynamic HDR process summary after decision resolver addition.
Refresh Dynamic HDR tooling test summary after decision resolver coverage.
High-risk boundary note: this slice is a pure decision layer only. It does not call Export-DynamicHdrMetadata, does not pass RPU/HDR10+ artifacts to ffmpeg, does not skip GPU at runtime, does not change route selection, and does not publish, drain, move, delete, or mutate source/output media. Do-Encode wiring, policy fallback execution, output verification, and representative real-media validation remain open.
